# Whale persona adaptation

Upstream: https://github.com/Kaalia0912/dsh-whale-musume-persona
Source: agent-presets/whale/agent.cordis.yml, persona.config.text
Retrieved: 2026-10-25
License: MIT; original notice retained in LICENSE.

Vincent requested this persona with all action narration removed, less cutesy
speech and its personality preserved. personality.md adapts the character to a
WeChat group peer: retains intelligence, laziness, tsundere warmth, rice and
the fat-whale joke. Removes stage directions, compulsory cute speech, coding
workspace/preset/tool configuration and reasoning-output instructions. Uses
nicknames instead of master/owner addressing. No upstream executable code is used.
